title: sic-molecule-squeezer: end-to-end open-source design of a 4H-SiC photonic-molecule squeezed-light source
description: Complete simulation pipeline (FEM waveguide dispersion, Lugiato-Lefever soliton crystals, linearized multimode quantum model) for the article 'Photonic-molecule extraction of multimode squeezed light from a dispersion-engineered 4H-silicon-carbide soliton-crystal microcomb'.
